sanskrit:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ॥ ११-५४॥
iast:
bhaktyā tvananyayā śakya ahamevaṃvidho’rjuna
jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa 11-54
translation: But, by single-minded devotion, can I, of this Form, be known and seen in reality, and also entered into, O Parantapa (O scorcher of your foes)!
